source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 312 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-312.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 312 was established by Ordinance No. 20314, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 24, 1989. Ordinance No. 20314 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20314; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-312.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 312 is established on property generally located at the southeast corner of Inwood Road and Stemmons Freeway (I-35). The size of PD 312 is approximately 30.48 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20314; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-312.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Use Regulations And Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-312.104. USE REGULATIONS AND DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

Pursuant to the general transition policies approved by the city council on July 22, 1987 per Resolution No. 87-2319, this article establishes PD 312 for the limited purpose of avoiding structural nonconformity. The use regulations and development standards for PD 312 are as follows.

(1) Except as otherwise provided in Paragraph (2), all property in PD 312 shall be treated as though it were in the MU-3 district and be subject to all future amendments of the Dallas City Code affecting the MU-3 district.

(2) The parking garage shown on the improvement survey and elevations (Exhibit 312A) is legally permitted. (Ord. Nos. 20314; 25850)

sections.title: Effect On Permit Applications
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-312.105. EFFECT ON PERMIT APPLICATIONS.

(a) A person who has filed a complete application for a building permit pursuant to Chapter 52, “Administrative Procedures for the Construction Codes,” of the Dallas City Code, as amended, before May 24, 1989, is entitled to issuance of the permit if the building official determines that:

(1) the plans and specifications submitted are in compliance with all applicable laws and ordinances in effect at the time the application was filed;

(2) the work described in the application conforms to the requirements of the construction codes in effect at the time the application was filed; and

(3) the appropriate fee specified in Chapter 52 has been paid.

(b) The building official shall reject an application if:

(1) it is not complete;

(2) it describes work that does not conform to the requirements of all applicable codes, ordinances, and laws in effect at the time the application was filed; or

(3) the applicant fails to obtain the permit within 90 days of the date written notice is given that the application has been approved.

(c) Written notice is given by depositing it properly addressed and postage paid in the United States Mail. The address on the notice must be the same as that provided by the applicant on the application.

(d) If an application filed before May 24, 1989, is rejected by the building official after May 24, 1989, or if a permit issued before May 24, 1989, is revoked by the building official after May 24, 1989, any reapplication must describe work that conforms to the requirements of the applicable new zoning district classification established by the article. (Ord. Nos. 20314; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-312.106. ZONING MAP.

PD 312 is located on Zoning Map No. I-6. (Ord. Nos. 20314; 25850)
